svg.title: Huat Bot architecture
svg.text: Singapore Pools TOTO: what the next draws will do and the next big prize
Projects the jackpot to the cascade
7.30pm SGT on draw days, retries for 2 hours
Every figure comes from Python. Draws are independent, so the bot never suggests numbers.
